name: groundwork
description: Groundwork shared agent tooling: drive-pr runs a pull request's review rounds unattended, do-issue works an issue-tracker issue through to a pull request, resolve-review-comments settles review threads, and the review-arbiter agent rules on contested findings. Each repository supplies its own values in .config/groundwork-overlay.yaml.

interface.shortDescription: Shared agent skills for pull request and issue work
